_documentation.purpose: Map nodes that touch protection of commercial software. Restricted nodes stay on the map, but hints are conceptual only and practice is redirected to the author's own lab binaries.
rules: restricted=true requires a note and at least one redirect lab id (labNN / cmNN).
Any Top 200 entry whose catalog text (title + engine + what_to_find) matches PROTECTION_RX in Tools_and_Scripts/dojo_schema.py MUST be listed here with restricted=true.
Optional exclude_items {techniques: [...], tools: [...]}: ids that are never shown for this node, whatever the catalog says.
Broader words (encryption, bypass, online, offline-qualified titles) are only reported: python Tools_and_Scripts/validate_games.py --protection-report

online_note_games: NOT restricted, but the game also has an online mode. The map shows an offline-only banner (anti-cheat off, never go online) and hints must stay offline: ONLINE_CONTEXT_RX in dojo_schema.py (online, multiplayer, ranked, server; RU: онлайн, мультиплеер, сервер, ранкед/рейтинговый) is an error there.
Campaign quests are keyed by a stable substring of their README.md line (readme_match), not by line number.

g176.note: Encrypted / obfuscated IL2CPP metadata of an online-service game (local private sandbox context). Conceptual hints only: what global-metadata is, why a publisher encrypts or obfuscates it, and what that protects. No dumping or decryption steps; Il2CppDumper is not suggested. Hands-on practice happens only on your own binaries (CM 03 cipher, Lab 10 XOR-encrypted RAM + integrity, CM 05).

g177.note: Custom metadata encryption in an online-service game (offline local server context). Conceptual hints only: how metadata registration and its encryption are designed and why. No dumping or decryption steps; Il2CppDumper is not suggested. Hands-on practice happens only on your own binaries (CM 03 cipher, Lab 10 XOR-encrypted RAM + integrity, CM 05).

g199.note: Commercial integrity protection (Arxan). Conceptual hints only: what an integrity check is and how it is designed. Hands-on practice happens only on your own binaries (Lab 10, CM 05).
